text:
kelsey: Preflight check — Aurora POC cutover targeted for Fri 9:00am PT. Sending a compact checklist so owners can confirm. Reply with ✅ when done or call out blockers.

Checklist (owners):
1) Network egress + firewall rules — ajay
2) Staging certs + SSO smoke — sam
3) Model pin + canary config — maria
4) Observability hooks + eval set upload — jordan-se
5) Runbook + docs + rollback steps — tyler
6) Final demo script + sample payloads — kelsey

Any missing items? Also please drop expected ETA for each item.

ajay: Taking network. Need the list of customer CIDRs and whether we need VPN peering or just public IP allowlist. ETA: EOD Thu for firewall rules + test. Opening infra ticket INF-842.

sam: I’ll handle certs/SSO. Staging certs already issued, just need an IdP test user from Aurora team to validate SAML attributes. ETA: Thu morning if I get creds today.

maria: I’ll own the model pin/canary. Plan: pin to redwood-v2-7B-quant, run a 5% canary in staging for 2 hours, validate latency + regression tests. PR up: github.com/redwood/inference/pulls/487 — needs one review. ETA: Thu midday to merge and schedule canary.

jordan-se: Observability: adding p50/p95 latency, token cost, and fallback count. Uploading eval set now to S3. Path: s3://redwood-evals/aurora/prompt_set_v3 . Will add Grafana dashboard tile for the rollout. ETA: today 6pm PT.

tyler: Runbook + docs: drafting the cutover runbook and rollback steps. Need the exact fallback policy wording from product before finalizing (what to do if canary fails). ETA: Thu morning.

kelsey: Demo script: I’ll author a short happy-path + failure-path script and include example payloads. Proposing a dry run Thu 4:00pm PT — who can join?

ajay: Thur 4p works for me. :thumbsup:

sam: I have a calendar conflict but can try to join; if not, please record.

maria: Dry run works for me — will also validate canary rollback flow.

jordan-se: I will not post secrets here — DMing Sam the test IdP creds now.

---
Code snippet for firewall rule (ajay asked for example):
```bash
# allow Aurora public IPs to staging inference endpoint
gcloud compute firewall-rules create allow-aurora --network=prod-vpc --allow tcp:443 --source-ranges=52.12.34.56/32,18.23.45.0/24
```

deploy-bot: deploy-bot scheduled: canary rollout for redwood-v2-7B-quant -> staging at 2024-05-09T22:00:00Z (initiated by maria).

kelsey: Quick action items summary — please react with ✅ when your item is done: 
- ajay: firewall rules + INF-842 (ETA Thu EOD)
- sam: SSO test + confirm staging certs (ETA Thu AM)
- maria: merge PR + schedule canary (ETA Thu midday)
- jordan-se: upload evals + dashboard (DONE) ✅
- tyler: runbook + rollback wording (ETA Thu AM)
- kelsey: demo script + dry run (scheduled Thu 4pm PT)

If anyone sees an unlisted blocker (eg. peering windows, DB migration, IP rotation), call it out here. Otherwise I’ll kick off the dry run invite after we hit 4/6 ✅s.

ajay: noted — will post INF-842 link and test results once firewall is applied.✅

maria: I’ll ping for the dry run when PR is merged.

sam: will confirm SSO by 11am PT.

kelsey: thanks all — moving to follow-up thread for post-dry-run notes.
